children: Morgan Stanley had a strong quarter, CEO Ted Pick says, with EPS up 8.2% to $3.03 and net revenues up 12% to $20.34 billion. Analysts polled by FactSet expected quarterly EPS of $2.93 a share on revenue of $19.93 billion. "Institutional Securities benefited from global strength, led by our Equity franchise, and Wealth Management reported record revenues and added $232 billion in net new assets and $80 billion in fee-based flows," Pick says in prepared earnings remarks. "Across Wealth and Investment Management, total client assets grew to $10.5 trillion, demonstrating the scale of our platform and the strength of our franchise." Looking ahead, Pick says Morgan Stanley will continue to invest for growth while delivering returns for shareholders. Morgan Stanley slightly lower premarket. (connor.hart@wsj.com)
